name: OK-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Frank Lucas running for reelection
Democratic challenger with no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~1%
model.rationale: The baseline of roughly R+20 rests on a heavily Republican district, a well-funded incumbent, and a challenger with no visible campaign resources; nothing in the dossier justifies moving away from it.
model.watch: A surprise wave environment or major Lucas scandal could narrow the margin, though a Democratic win remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Oklahoma's 3rd District is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of about R+23. Frank Lucas, the longtime incumbent, is running for reelection and holds a large financial advantage, having raised over $900,000 with more than $500,000 on hand. His Democratic opponent, Suzie Byrd, has no reported fundraising or cash on hand.

With no public polling, no expert ratings, and prediction markets giving Democrats roughly a one percent chance, the forecast rests on fundamentals. The expected margin is about twenty points Republican, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling but the strength of the structural factors favoring Lucas.
